resolvedBlockingFindings.source: Primary-Source Audit B1 + Bilingual Reader Review B1
resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: EN cl-p3o24-four-domain-propagation inverted the physical causal direction of Ekvall et al. (2021) (writing that diverted plastics displace imported waste instead of freeing capacity that draws in imported combustible waste), while ZH wrote 本地焚烧发电 omitting heat (热电).
resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Aligned both ZH and EN to the exact physically accurate diversion-and-freed-capacity framing with local heat and power (本地焚烧热电 / local heat and power generation).

resolvedBlockingFindings.source: Primary-Source Audit B2 + Bilingual Reader Review B5
resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: cl-p3o24-boundaries-and-double-counting and Table 1 Row 1 Col 4 collapsed ILCD 2010 §6.5.4 Provision I.a into 'otherwise fall back to two-step allocation', contradicting ev-sub105-ilcd-conditions and Section 5 cl-sub105-fallbacks; Table 1 also added unattached 'C2 always allocates'.
resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Restored ILCD's exact two-branch distinction (insufficient market scale checks broader equivalent function or shifts to Situation B; Provision I.a.iv.4 falls back to allocation only when substitution modeling is infeasible and generic data are insufficient) and aligned C2 to ev-gs23-ilcd-ch5-goal-contexts (excludes cross-system crediting).

resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: cl-p3o24-boundaries-and-double-counting and Table 1 Row 1 Col 4 narrowed GHG Protocol Product Standard §9.3.2 to 'average factors' alone, omitting 'supplier-specific' factors verified in ev-mkt169-ghgp-attributional-allocation.
resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Updated both ZH and EN claim text and Table 1 Row 1 Col 4 to state supplier-specific or average factors (供应商或平均因子).

resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: Table 1 cited CFF quality ratios & substitution point, eGRID2023 Rev. 2 direct CO2, AVERT 4.3.0 patch version, and busbar-vs.-end-use loss denominators without attaching their primary evidence rows to cl-p3o24-four-domain-propagation; ZH Row 4 Col 4 attached quality-ratio virgin substitution to the factor B clause.
resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Attached ev-cff109-2022-equation, ev-cff109-2022-quality, ev-kb48-main-egrid2023-rev2-srl23-erct, ev-kb48-avertweb43-release-config, ev-kb48-main-egrid2023-guide-ggl-method, and ev-kb48-future-cambium2024-report-delivery; rewrote ZH Row 4 Col 4 so like-for-like quality-ratio adjustment modifies the material-recycling (A) clause.

resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: cl-p3o24-attributional-vs-consequential cited ILCD §§6.5.4.3–6.5.4.4 for Situation A's average-mix practical simplification, omitting §6.5.4.2 and ev-sub105-ilcd-proxy-purpose.
resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Updated citation to §§6.5.4.2–6.5.4.4 in both ZH and EN and attached ev-sub105-ilcd-proxy-purpose and ev-gs23-ilcd-ch5-goal-contexts.

resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: cl-p3o24-four-domain-propagation grouped EU PEF Annex I §4.5 with ILCD §6.5.3 as a consequential system-expansion route, blurring PEF §4.5 Step 1 (whole-system expansion) and Step 2 (direct substitution).
resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Attributed adding missing functions / subtracting displaced reference supply under system expansion specifically to ILCD §6.5.3 and separately distinguished EU PEF Annex I §4.5 Step 1 whole-system expansion vs. Step 2 direct substitution.

resolvedBlockingFindings.source: Bilingual Reader Review B2 + Primary-Source Audit N4

resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Restored exact subject in EN Row 4 Col 4 and aligned Row 4 Col 5 across ZH and EN on A/B conventions, quality ratios, point of substitution, and local heat/power recovery double-crediting.

resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Updated publicSummary.title.en to 'Added Attribution and System Response Opening Section and Four-Domain Comparison Table to Part III'.

resolvedBlockingFindings.resolution: Moved Table 1 immediately after Claim 2 (cl-p3o24-four-domain-propagation) and before Claim 3 (cl-p3o24-boundaries-and-double-counting) in both ZH and EN MDX files, and synchronized Claim 3's closing handoff across ZH and EN.

resolvedBlockingFindings.issue: Section 1 Claim 1 re-defined all four Ekvall & Tillman (1997) / Ekvall et al. (2005) terms verbatim right before Section 2 opened by introducing those exact same papers and re-expanding 'retrospective LCA'.
